item.title: About language learning
item.description:
5 principles

Principle 1 Focus on language content that is relevant to you

Principle 2 Use new languages as a tool to communicate from day 1, like a baby

Principle 3 Comprehension is the key

Principle 4 Language learning is about physiological training, it’s about muscles

Principle 5 be happy and relaxed, and must learn to tolerate ambiguity

7 actions

Action 1 Listen A LOT

brain soaking

Action 2 focus on body language

Action 3 Start mixing

speak like a baby: get creative, do not have to be perfect

item.title: The Road Not Taken
item.description:
Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
And sorry I could not travel both
And be one traveler, long I stood
And looked down one as far as I could
To where it bent in the undergrowth;

Then took the other, as just as fair,
And having perhaps the better claim,
Because it was grassy and wanted wear;
Though as for that the passing there
Had worn them really about the same,
